metadata.anchor_selection: Three non-collinear surface tracks selected offline for spatial spread and measured co-motion; not semantic task landmarks.
metadata.frame_rule: origin=A; X=unit(B-A); Y=unit((C-A)-dot(C-A,X)X); Z=X cross Y
metadata.propagation: Each adjacent frame pair fits a rigid transform using shared supported TrackEverything points excluding A/B/C; the composed transform carries their frame-361 coordinates.
metadata.limitation: Adjacent-frame coherence does not prove long-term material identity: chaining can drift, and even a supported raw point can change physical location. This is within-demo propagation only; a live run still needs cross-episode correspondence.
